# Image Translator

Image translator: translate the text inside an image from your MegaScenes library and get the same image back with the translation in place, for comics, menus, signs, posters and slides.

## What it does
Pick an image from your MegaScenes library and choose the language. Claude tells you the price and returns the same picture with the text translated, keeping the art and layout.

**How the files are made:** each image translation is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The new lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install image-translator@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Image Translator talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/image-translator/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each image translation uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The image translations show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_image_translation_models` | Models for image translations with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_image_translation_cost` | Exact price of one image translation before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_image_translation` | Starts one image translation in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_image_translation` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Translate the text in my latest MegaScenes image into Spanish"
- "Translate my last comic page from my library into English"
- "Turn my menu photo into a Japanese version"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the image translation (the image you pick from your library and the target language) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
